title: For each RBAC action, show the action name and the geometric mean of subnet
question: For each RBAC action, show the action name and the geometric mean of subnet IP versions (IPv4/IPv6) across the subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry, considering only subnets with an IP version greater than 0 and only RBAC entries whose action is either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external'. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
  r.action,
  EXP(AVG(LN(s.ip_version))) AS geometric_mean_ip_version
FROM networkrbacs AS r
JOIN subnets AS s
  ON r.object_id = s.network_id
WHERE r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external')
  AND s.ip_version > 0
GROUP BY r.action;

SELECT
  r.action,
  EXP(AVG(LN(s.ip_version))) AS geometric_mean_ip_version
FROM networkrbacs AS r
JOIN subnets AS s
  ON r.object_id = s.network_id
WHERE r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external')
  AND s.ip_version > 0
GROUP BY r.action;
